## Description

Please provide a summary of the change, related issues, and architectural context.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] Code adheres to zero-emoji policy across all files, comments, and commit messages.
- [ ] Tests have been added/updated covering the changes.
- [ ] `npm run test` passes locally.
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds without warnings or errors.
- [ ] TypeScript types are exported where applicable.
